rows.text: Once, an unlucky thief stumbled upon a black-robed old man on the roadside. Showing his whip-lashed, swollen legs, the thief knelt and begged for a hiding place to escape his pursuers. The old man graciously opened his robe, signaling the thief to hide inside. When the pursuers arrived, all they found was a squeaking, lame black rat, while the old man had vanished along with the Thief Star, Zagreus.
